ChurchStream is free Windows software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**. It streams the service to YouTube and Facebook and runs the projector — hymns, Bible readings, announcements and names — from one simple control panel that also works on a phone or tablet.

## Download
**[ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.2.0/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip)** — unzip anywhere and double-click **ChurchStream.exe**. Nothing to install; FFmpeg is included. Updating? Copy the new files over your old ChurchStream folder; your **ChurchStream-data** folder (settings, songs, services) is kept.

> The first time, Windows SmartScreen may say it doesn't recognise the app (it isn't code-signed). Click **More info → Run anyway**.

## New in 0.2.0
**For volunteers**
- **Volunteer mode** — a simple screen with settings, stream setup and editing hidden. Turn it on with the lock button; press and hold the chip for 2 seconds to leave. Remembered per device.
- **Phone remote** — any phone on the church Wi-Fi becomes the clicker: huge Next and Back, Clear / Logo / Black, what's next, and the order of service to tap. Scan the QR code in Settings → Phones & tablets.
- **Undo** — removing an item, starting a new service or opening one shows an **Undo** button (or press Ctrl+Z).
- **User manual** — built in: click **?** in the top bar.

**For worship**
- **Pick the verses to sing** for each hymn (e.g. 1, 2 and 4); refrains follow their verse.
- **Responsive readings** from any Bible passage — leader and congregation take turns, the last verse is read by all, and the congregation's words show in gold.
- **Printable order of service** (Save / open → Print) with your logo, hymn numbers, verses and readings.
- **Projector text options** — font, words in the middle or along the bottom, centred or left, and an outline for busy photos.

**For online viewers**
- **Sound clean-up** (Off / Light / Strong) — removes hum and fan noise, evens out voices and prevents distortion.
- **Mic level** and **lip-sync** controls for when the sound and picture don't match.

**Fixes**
- The **+ Add** menu could hide behind the slides when you pointed at it.

## Also in ChurchStream
Streaming to YouTube and Facebook at once (with recording), camera / slides / picture-in-picture views, names and a ticker on the stream, the *SDA Hymnal* (1985) and *Church Hymnal* (1941), KJV and BSB Bibles, sermon slides from PDF, countdowns and sunset times, videos and background music (including YouTube), saving and sharing services, and a clean, touch-friendly design.

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use). Playing recordings on a live stream can get it muted by YouTube or Facebook.
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
